mathematical_review.cellular_map_filtrations: For cellular f:X→Y, f(X^p)⊆Y^p. The induced cohomological skeletal-pair maps are h^n(Y^p,Y^{p−1})→h^n(X^p,X^{p−1}), and absolute-skeleton maps are h^n(Y^p)→h^n(X^p). Homology maps have the covariant direction from X to Y.
mathematical_review.exact_couples_and_pages: Pair-sequence naturality supplies maps of skeletal exact couples. The exact-couple morphism induces maps on each E_r page; each d_r square commutes, and the induced maps respect E_{r+1} as the next-page homology/transition. Cohomology and homology arrows must retain their opposite variance.
mathematical_review.theory_morphisms: For a theory morphism φ: h̃→k̃, the coefficient-theory maps point h̃^*(−)→k̃^*(−) and h̃_*(−)→k̃_*(−); these commute with the skeletal structure when suspension and connecting maps are respected.
mathematical_review.edge_maps: The exact-couple structural maps identify with the edge maps and the abutment filtration maps/quotients. A schematic should attach the edge comparison to the stable page and associated filtration, without implying the edge map is an isomorphism or conflating the filtration quotient with the whole abutment.

diagram_recommendation.content: A compact paired schematic can show (1) cellular skeleta X^p→Y^p and the induced skeletal exact-couple map, (2) the generic pagewise naturality square E_r(X)→E_r(Y) over d_r, with the next-page transition indicated, and (3) stable edge/filtration compatibility. Separate or visibly label cohomology (reverse X,Y direction) and homology (forward X,Y direction); optionally show theory morphisms as a second, vertical comparison. Check indices and variance consistently against the cited cohomological and homological AHSS conventions. A full diagram for every page is unnecessary; the generic r square represents all r.
diagram_recommendation.confidence: moderate: the naturality square would clarify the statement's several layers, but a dense exact-couple plus edge-map diagram could be harder to read than the prose.
